# R.J. Sayle Plumbing & Heating Ltd

> Gas Safe registered commercial and domestic plumbing and heating specialists based on the Wirral, Merseyside. Fixed-price contracts. 20+ years experience. Serving the Wirral peninsula and nationwide.

## Services

- Boiler installations (combi, system, conventional — all leading manufacturers)
- Emergency plumbing — burst pipes, leaks, boiler breakdowns (same-day response)
- Radiator installation and replacement
- Unvented cylinder installation (G3 qualified)
- Power flushing
- Commercial plumbing and heating fit-outs
- Residential plumbing
- Boosted cold water storage systems
- Air source heat pump installation
- Above-ground drainage

## Coverage Areas

Primary: Wirral, Merseyside, including Heswall, West Kirby, Bebington, Birkenhead, Wallasey, Hoylake, Neston, Ellesmere Port, Liverpool

Extended: North West England, Wales, Midlands, Yorkshire, London, Scotland — nationwide for commercial and specialist projects

## FAQ

**Are you Gas Safe registered?**
Yes. R.J. Sayle Plumbing & Heating Ltd is fully Gas Safe registered, legally authorised to carry out all gas work in the UK. Verify at GasSafeRegister.co.uk.

**Do you offer emergency plumbing on the Wirral?**
Yes. Emergency callouts across the Wirral and Merseyside for burst pipes, boiler breakdowns, and leaks. Call 07450 237593 to speak directly to an engineer for a same-day response.

**Do you offer fixed-price contracts?**
Yes — all work is priced on a fixed-price basis. No hidden costs. Call 07450 237593 or use the contact form for a free, no-obligation quote.

**What areas do you cover?**
Based on the Wirral. Cover the entire peninsula: Heswall, West Kirby, Bebington, Birkenhead, Wallasey, Hoylake, Neston, Ellesmere Port, and Liverpool. Commercial and large domestic projects taken anywhere in the UK.

**What plumbing and heating services do you offer?**
Boiler installations, radiator installation, emergency plumbing, unvented cylinder installation, power flushing, commercial plumbing and heating, residential plumbing, boosted cold water storage, air source heat pumps, and above-ground drainage. Fixed-price on all work.

**How experienced are you?**
20+ years of commercial and domestic plumbing and heating experience with 500+ completed projects.

**Do you work on commercial properties?**
Yes. Full commercial fit-outs including boosted cold water systems, commercial heating, and above-ground drainage. Nationwide for commercial projects.
